agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Rogers diffusion, peer position and timing evidence

analytical_question: What has spread among organizations using humanoid mobile manipulators for indoor physical work, and how should evidence about comparable campus stockrooms influence the timing of NYU's proposed test?
general_et_finding: GXO and BMW report bounded industrial programs. GXO and Agility are identifiable customer and supplier partners, but the packet does not measure their influence on others' decisions. It identifies neither a campus opinion leader nor a demonstrated standards-driven effect on diffusion. For organizations sustaining indoor humanoid work, classification among innovators, early adopters, early majority, late majority and laggards is indeterminate. Publicized participants establish existence but cannot locate adopters on a representative adoption timeline.
application_finding: The dossier supplies analogues for handling goods but no observed comparison for supervised transfers from a staging table to low shelves on this fixed route. Relative advantage is unknown: compare completed, correctly placed totes per staff-hour, including handoffs, supervision and recovery. Compatibility is unknown: check shelf clearance, tote fit and interference with staff on the proposed route. Complexity (higher means harder) may rise with setup, training and recovery; record staff time and interventions. Trialability is observed for GXO's industrial pilot only; for this task, verify short-term equipment access, operator support and ability to restore the manual workflow. Observability is a hypothesis: confirm that an observer can score stable placement and interventions consistently across the cart, humanoid and, if feasible, wheeled robot with human handoff. These are proposed measurements. Stage for sustained use of this particular workflow is indeterminate.
organization_specific_finding: The relevant peer population is comparable higher-education campus stockrooms; the behavior of interest is sustained supervised tote-to-shelf service. The packet provides neither a peer sampling frame nor dated adoption histories, so stage and NYU's relative position are indeterminate. NYU is a hypothetical candidate for trial design, with site, operator, budget, insurance and permissions unknown. Its cautious posture increases the local evidence needed before testing. A more aggressive posture could shorten the desired information-gathering period but would leave the external observations and workflow assessment unchanged.

evidence.claim: A logistics customer and supplier announced a commercial agreement following a pilot.
evidence.date_or_recency: Published 2024-06-27; pilot preceded publication, exact observation interval unspecified.
evidence.notes: Unit is the named industrial program. Geography and wider eligible population are unspecified in the packet.

evidence.claim: The partnership continued, with further sites planned.
evidence.notes: Same partnership as R1. Planned sites supply no observed adoption events or campus data.

evidence.claim: BMW reports bounded industrial use and results.
evidence.date_or_recency: Published 2026-02-27; underlying observation intervals unspecified in packet.
evidence.notes: The release addresses production in Germany; scope is BMW plants, with no representative adopter denominator.

evidence.claim: Industrial robot guidance identifies worker-safety considerations.
evidence.source_or_reference: R4, OSHA, Industrial Robots and Robot System Safety
evidence.date_or_recency: Publication date unspecified; verify applicability before a test.
evidence.notes: Provides questions for the safety reviewer; supplies no diffusion observations.

evidence.claim: The proposed campus scenario permits a comparison in principle.
evidence.source_or_reference: C1, team-proposed NYU stockroom use case
evidence.notes: One hypothetical NYU route. No location approval, implementation, performance or worker acceptance observed.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: A continuing commercial relationship strengthens evidence beyond a demonstration. It can coexist with limited spread elsewhere.

No campus observations appear in the packet. That gap cannot establish zero campus adoption. Announcements, pilots, installed robots, active sites and stockrooms sustaining the workflow measure different things.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence that the packet documents selected industrial programs. Confidence in a campus diffusion stage, relative advantage or timing forecast is insufficient.
value_opportunity_implication: Measure whether reaching a shelf saves enough human handling time to offset setup and supervision. Record transport and final placement separately so the contribution of shelf access is visible.
risk_governance_implication: Ask affected workers about displacement and route access, EHS about falling loads and emergency response, and IT/privacy about camera records. Safety controls and fallback are proposals requiring local verification.
recommendation_management_implication: There is no evidenced peer deadline. For the present design decision, management can gather site and comparator information and predefine observation criteria. If an approved short test occurs, review its records afterward as local feasibility evidence. The Adoption Agent owns authorization advice and any future scale judgment.
change_monitoring_triggers: Reassess stage when a dated survey or registry states geography, eligible campus stockrooms, sampling coverage, workflow definition, sustained-use interval and adoption dates. Report the share of eligible stockrooms using the workflow separately from robot counts or pilot activity.
Check dated follow-up on GXO plans, independent uptime and intervention records, and evidence of renewals or discontinuations. A confirmed industrial site updates the industrial record only.

Refresh provider terms, insurance and support and verify NYU access, staffing, privacy and safety review before scheduling any test. After an approved test, review matched comparator records with staff.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Abstain from a numerical adoption share, Rogers category and diffusion-speed forecast at both general and campus levels until representative dated evidence identifies who adopted and when.
Request comparable peer records that distinguish a demonstration, temporary evaluation and sustained stockroom service; request local baseline handling and supervision measurements.
